text: [155] 65 catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano . katamehi catūhi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu sutānañca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo .pe. atthassa viññāpaniyā sandassako ca hoti .pe. sabrahmacārīnaṃ . imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano .
